# tucan v0.6.0 - Table of Contents

A plotting library on top of VegaLite

## Pages

- [Overview](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [License](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

- Guides
  - [Time series plots in Tucan](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/time_series_plots_in_tucan.md)

## Modules

- Plots
  - [Tucan](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.md): A high level API interface for creating plots on top of `VegaLite`.
  - [Tucan.Finance](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Finance.md): Financial plots.
  - [Tucan.Geometry](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Geometry.md): An API for drawing common geometrical shapes.

- Layout
  - [Tucan.Layers](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Layers.md): Utility functions for working with layered plots.

- Styling
  - [Tucan.Axes](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Axes.md): Utilities for configuring plot axes.

  - [Tucan.Grid](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Grid.md): Helper utilities for customizing a plot's grid.

  - [Tucan.Legend](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Legend.md): Helper utilities for configuring the plot legend.

  - [Tucan.Scale](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Scale.md): Utilities for working with Vega-Lite scales.
  - [Tucan.Themes](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Themes.md): Helper functions for `Tucan` theme.
  - [Tucan.View](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.View.md): Helper utilities for customizing the plot view.

- Utilities
  - [Tucan.Export](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Export.md): Various export methods for `Tucan` plots.

- Datasets
  - [Tucan.Datasets](https://tucan.hexdocs.pm/Tucan.Datasets.md): Common datasets for `Tucan` demos and docs.
